description: This Python source file defines a class 'PassThroughStreamingHandler' responsible for processing streaming responses from various LLM service providers (e.g., Anthropic, Vertex AI, OpenAI). It includes methods for chunk processing, logging, and extracting model information, tailored for a proxy handling streaming API responses within a larger LLM infrastructure.
